# DiceAlly 2.4.0

- Mark any inventory item as a container and move items into or out of it from the item details or editor.
- Expand and collapse nested containers in the inventory; store container flags and membership separately from item data using stable item IDs.
- Keep visible contents accessible when a container is hidden or filtered out, preserving the saved nesting.
- Prevent circular assignments and move contents up one level when a container is deleted or unmarked.

Validation: All 32 focused tests passed (4 Node tests and 28 Angular tests), including inventory grouping, filters, hidden entries, container membership and item controls. Angular templates compiled successfully.
